item.title: Kunzite is pink-to-violet spodumene
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Kunzite is a pink to violet gem variety of spodumene, appreciated for its delicate colors.
EXIMUTC view: Consider light sensitivity when selecting and storing the gem.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/kunzite-description
